title: Zhang Fei Whips the Government Inspector; He Jin Plots to Kill the Eunuchs
summary: The rebellion is broken and the brothers are given a county post so small it is an insult. When a government inspector arrives demanding a bribe, Zhang Fei ties him to a post and flogs him with a willow switch, and the three of them are fugitives again.

At court the Emperor Ling dies. The General-in-Chief He Jin, a butcher's son raised by his sister's place in the harem, resolves to destroy the ten eunuchs who run the palace — and is talked into summoning the frontier armies to help him do it.
history: The flogging is the novel's invention, and a characteristic one: the histories give the deed to Liu Bei, who is a good deal less genial than the story lets him be.

pins.note: Flogs the inspector and takes to the road.
Summoning the frontier generals to the capital.
Alone in warning that this will end badly.
Dies of illness; his brothers are hunted down.
